title: Earthquake hits Delhi, India
summary: An earthquake with a magnitude of 2.9 occurred in Delhi on August 2, 2026, at 4:14 am local time. The epicenter was located in the northern district of Delhi, and the depth was approximately 8 kilometers. According to the National Seismology Centre, the quake caused significant shaking.
summary_points: An earthquake with a magnitude of 2.9 occurred in Delhi on August 2, 2026, at 4:14 am local time.
The epicenter was located in the northern district of Delhi, and the depth was approximately 8 kilometers.
According to the National Seismology Centre, the quake caused significant shaking.
summary_hi: दिल्ली में 2 अगस्त 2026 को तड़के 4:14 बजे भूकंप आया. इस भूकंप का केंद्र दिल्ली के उत्तरी जिले में था और इसकी गहराई 8 किलोमीटर थी. राष्ट्रीय भूकंप विज्ञान केंद्र के अनुसार, इस भूकंप ने महत्वपूर्ण हिलावट पैदा की.
